background_gradient.role: canvas background on all four canvases

surface2.role: meta chips and card ID badges

accent.role: rule bar, card accent bar, ID badges, website

watermark.role: S/V monogram on desktop and stage

typography.line_height: every Text sets height=1.2 (line box = 1.2 x fontSize)

section_gaps.tablet: 14 between chips, 24 card gaps, 32+ to footer

card_padding.mobile: title at +9, detail at +33, left inset 16 (bar 4px)
card_padding.tablet: title at +28, detail at +78, left inset 24
card_padding.desktop: title at +44, detail at +96, left inset 26
card_padding.stage: title at +56, detail at +116, left inset 30

components.name: gradient background
components.rule: full-canvas LINEAR gradient top->bottom on every canvas

components.name: header block
components.rule: title (BOLD) + subtitle stacked; accent rule bar 3px below

components.name: meta chip
components.rule: surface2 rounded chip; stacked full-width on mobile, inline row on the rest; date/time mono, location sans

components.name: CTA pill
components.rule: amber rounded pill with centered BOLD dark label; full width on mobile, left of website row on larger canvases; text only, no QR

components.name: card
components.rule: surface rounded card + 4px accent left bar + mono ID badge top-right + BOLD title + detail line; grid 1/2/3 columns at mobile/tablet/desktop+stage

components.name: footer
components.rule: hairline + website (mono accent) + date echo (mono text3, END aligned); omitted on mobile by re-layout, present on tablet/desktop/stage

components.name: watermark
components.rule: S/V monogram in near-bg color at large sizes; desktop and stage only (kept clear of every text box)

adaptation_rules.no_cropping: every canvas is an independent DSL layout built from the same content + tokens
adaptation_rules.no_scaling: no Image widget is used at all; sizes are chosen per breakpoint
adaptation_rules.same_semantics: identical component stack, colors and hierarchy; only column counts and spacing change
